creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-09-28: "a bit more right-clicking control": right-click an agent in the agent list, a tab, or anywhere in a pane, and get the controls you would expect there.

The one he spelled out: right-click a pane and split it, either on the same machine or starting the new pane on a different machine (a submenu naming every attached machine). That makes the right-click menu the way to make panes where you want them without the CLI.

Other items to consider, per place: rename, close, zoom, move to a new tab, new tab on a machine, copy and paste in a pane. Every item goes through the same core requests the keyboard and CLI use. Ghostty's macOS app (~/src/ghostty) has a right-click menu in a surface with split items, which is a model for the pane's. A pane whose program has asked for mouse reporting may need right-click passed through instead; decide the rule.

amterp, 2026-09-30: "right click on pane to copy muster id" - and on 2026-10-03, "build full thing": this card in full, with Copy Pane ID (the id `muster pane send --pane`, `muster msg post --to` and `$MUSTER_PANE` take) on the pane's menu, and the same for a tab's id and an agent row.
title: 🖱️ Right-click menus on an agent row, a tab, and a pane
